description: Continuous-excellence lot (improve-before-add, §4): generalize ODG's proven SBOM capability from npm-only to MULTI-ECOSYSTEM (npm/pypi/cargo/golang) by adding pure componentsFromManifest + buildSbomMulti to the canonical engine supply-chain-attest (both ports), reusable by BOTH evidence packs. Closes the in-code 'other ecosystems not covered' gap. No new primitive, no second engine, no duplication; existing buildSbom (npm) unchanged.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION ODG_UNIVERSAL_IT_EXECUTION_AND_CONTINUOUS_EXCELLENCE §4/§10 (smallest lot improving general capability, reuse-before-add).

work_item_contract.objective: componentsFromManifest(content, ecosystem) + buildSbomMulti(sources, meta): CycloneDX SBOM across npm/pypi/cargo/golang with correct purls; dedup; pure; fail-closed.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: CLAIM: ODG assurance is npm-only (compliance-evidence-pack.ts:18 flags the gap). REPRODUCTION: buildSbom only parses an npm packages map + hardcodes pkg:npm. ROOT CAUSE: single-ecosystem input shape + hardcoded purl. PLAN: add a pure multi-ecosystem parser in the canonical engine (both ports), keep buildSbom unchanged.
work_item_contract.scope: Two pure functions + exports in supply-chain-attest (both ports) + a hermetic test. Engine buildSbom/attestation/sign unchanged. No fetch/fs. supply-chain-attest is consumed via relative require (source twin) ⇒ no dist/core change needed.
invariants: Reuse/consolidate (one engine, both packs) — no new primitive/engine/registry/orchestrator.
buildSbom (npm) unchanged ⇒ existing behaviour + parity preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic test ALL PASS (pypi/cargo/golang/npm purls, buildSbomMulti merge+dedup+ecosystems metadata, fail-closed, dual-port parity); supply-chain-attest regression 7/7 incl JS/TS parity; tsc 0; live real public Cargo.lock (ripgrep 14.1.1) ⇒ 61 cargo components reproducible; final diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: A fix needs buildSbom change / a path outside the write-set / a new primitive.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/core/supply-chain-attest.{ts,js} src/runtime/sbom-multi-ecosystem.test.ts ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; delete contract.

objectives.goal: Multi-ecosystem SBOM in the canonical engine, reused by both packs.
done_when: Hermetic test + regression + parity green; tsc 0; live Cargo.lock ⇒ 61 comps reproducible; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: npm/pypi/cargo/golang SBOM shipped in supply-chain-attest (both ports), reusable by both evidence packs; proven hermetic + on real public Cargo.lock; buildSbom unchanged; committed (no force). A general-capability improvement, not a client contract.
